content:
{
  "phoneNote": "The accounting-receipt motif gives the page character, but widely separated hero links delay it and make the opening feel unnecessarily stretched.",
  "desktopNote": "The typographic direction is coherent, but oversized headings and the year dominate while the hero and process section leave substantial unused space.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Keep phone and email details in the main contact section; remove their immediate repetition in the footer and retain only business identifiers and legal links there.",
    "Tighten the phone hero by placing its contact links together and reducing their vertical gaps, bringing more of the receipt into the first screen.",
    "Reduce the desktop headline and year sizes, tighten the hero height, and arrange the coverage and collaboration sections side by side to eliminate broad empty areas."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Phone and desktop: the footer repeats the phone and email contact block immediately beneath the main contact section."
  ]
}
